name: Icon
summary: One glyph set, called by name — 259 icons imported from Figma, rendered by the shared <aha-icon>, never inline SVG.
lead: ONE shared element — <aha-icon name="system-bell"> — renders every glyph from a single registry built from Figma Design System V3 (259 icons across system / slide-type / file-type). Agents call a name; they never hand-author or paste an <svg>. Colour follows currentColor, size is 12/16/24/32, and filled/active states are dedicated -filled assets. Browse every name in the Icon library.

props.name: name
props.desc: Registry glyph name, e.g. system-bell, slidetype-poll, filetype-course

props.name: size
props.desc: On-grid pixel size; the master stroke scales with it

props.name: label
props.desc: Accessible name (role=img). Omit for a decorative icon

props.name: decorative
props.desc: aria-hidden — for an icon that only repeats adjacent text

whenToUse.when: the default for all product-UI chrome, buttons, menus, list rows, status
a selected/active/on state — e.g. system-bookmark-simple-filled; a solid glyph survives greyscale
labelling a slide kind or a file kind; file-type glyphs keep their baked brand colour

opinion.note: Call by name from the registry — never inline an <svg>, never pull a second icon set (Lucide/Heroicons/FontAwesome/@ant-design/icons). Off-grid sizes (no 20px) aren't supported. Icon-only buttons need an aria-label (and a tooltip when the meaning isn't obvious). If a glyph is genuinely missing, add the SVG under icons/svg and re-run build-icons.mjs.

codeNote: Same element + same registry → identical render in React and Vue. The geometry is imported from Figma DS V3 and normalised (ink #4A4A4A → currentColor) at build time by build-icons.mjs; the call site only names a glyph and a size.

selfCheck.label: called by name from the registry (no inline svg)
259 glyphs imported from Figma DS V3
colour = currentColor / token, no hex at call site
state via -filled asset, not a thicker stroke

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. Asserts the two promises: the requested size becomes the rendered box (24→24px, 16→16px), and a stroked glyph inherits currentColor (probe wrapped in #6A1EBB renders its stroke in that colour).
